# Verity Mod for Minecraft Guide

> VerityModChecker.online is an independent Verity Mod source checker, download guide, and troubleshooting hub for Minecraft Java, Bedrock, MCPE, VERITY.exe, Groq, Ollama, and voice setup searches.

## Core Pages

- [Verity Mod Download for Minecraft](https://veritymodchecker.online/): Current Java and Bedrock release map plus a browser-only URL, release record, filename, displayed-size, package, and SHA-256 checker.
- [Complete Verity Mod Route Index](https://veritymodchecker.online/routes/): Human-readable directory for Java, Bedrock, MCPE, download, play, server, voice, API, file, map, source-check, update, and troubleshooting routes.
- [Verity Mod Wiki](https://veritymodchecker.online/verity-mod-wiki/): Broad wiki hub for `Verity Mod Wiki`, story, creator, latest version, Java, Bedrock, MCPE, download, fix, source-data, and route-index searches; sends users to focused canonical pages instead of duplicating every install guide.
